description: This file defines the RawContact class, a low-level representation of a contact's data, including fields like name, phone numbers, email, and methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, along with constructors and utility methods.

classes.name: RawContact
classes.description: Represents a low-level contact with fields such as name, phone numbers, email, and status; includes methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and creation.

methods.name: getServerContactId
methods.description: Returns the server's contact ID associated with this RawContact.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Indicates whether the contact is marked as deleted.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Indicates whether the contact data has unsynced changes.

methods.name: getBestName
methods.description: Returns the best available name, prioritizing full name, then first name, then last name.

methods.name: toJSONObject
methods.description: Serializes the RawContact into a JSON object.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Creates a RawContact instance from a JSONObject.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new RawContact instance with given details.

methods.name: createDeletedContact
methods.description: Creates a minimal RawContact object representing a deleted contact.
